blksDefinition.completedCriteria: A block is complete when its calculated Proof-of-Work nonce meets or exceeds target difficulty bits and its Merkle leaf hash is anchored into the 13-level binary Merkle tree root.

v5LatticeDefinition.coordinateSpace: Discrete 4D integer grid V5 = {-2, -1, 0, 1, 2}^4 with undirected nearest-neighbor edges (Euclidean distance Delta = 1).
